nodes.label: Flag Inconsistent Reference Documents Rather Than Silently Resolving
nodes.norm_label: flag inconsistent reference documents rather than silently resolving
nodes.rationale: If a user-provided reference document is internally inconsistent, flag it instead of silently resolving it, and ask before propagating a fix at scale (e.g. correcting a buggy default across every farm's data).

nodes.label: Hide vs Delete Convention
nodes.rationale: When asked to hide (not delete) a feature, remove it from UI but keep supporting code/API intact, because 'hide' implies it may come back later.

nodes.label: Label Assumptions In The UI Itself
nodes.norm_label: label assumptions in the ui itself

nodes.label: Never Fabricate False Precision
nodes.rationale: Do not invent numbers (e.g. an alternate harvest date) that source data or formulas don't actually support, especially in the sugarcane weather/fertilizer forecast engine.
